name: claude-context-optimizer
description: Spend less of your Claude usage on re-reading. In chat: a fresh-start handoff, token checks and prompt sharpening. In Claude Code and Cowork: Haiku 5.5 subagents do the reading and test runs so the expensive model's context stays small, plus read dedup, budget and cache-break warnings, and /cco-audit of your own transcripts. Local, no telemetry.
